name: Smarter Taxiway Traffic
description:
[h1]Smarter Taxiway Traffic[/h1]
Aircraft stop getting stuck, and stop waiting around for planes that are nowhere near them.

[b]What you'll notice[/b]
[list]
[*]No more aircraft frozen nose to nose on a taxiway, stuck for good.
[*]Aircraft that have just landed no longer stop dead at the runway exit.
[*]Planes no longer sit waiting for traffic on the far side of the airport before crossing a junction.
[*]A plane won't push back into a taxiway something is already coming down. It waits at the stand instead, where it's out of everyone's way.
[*]On a taxiway only wide enough for one aircraft, traffic goes one way at a time rather than meeting in the middle.
[*]Emergencies, and aircraft still clearing a runway, go first.
[/list]

[b]Good to know[/b]
Works with the airport you already have. Nothing to place, nothing to set up.

Nothing is written into your save, so you can remove it whenever you like and nothing is left behind.

Every part of it can be switched off in Configuration Manager (F1) if you'd rather the game handled something itself.

[b]Requires[/b] AirportCEO Mod Loader.

[b]Still being tested — please report anything odd[/b]
This is new, and taxiway layouts vary enormously. If you see aircraft stuck, or holding when they clearly shouldn't be, please tell me — I can only fix what I can see.

Bug reports go here, where you can attach files straight to the report:
[url=https://github.com/Rhamnos/AirportCEO-smarter_taxiway_traffic/issues]https://github.com/Rhamnos/AirportCEO-smarter_taxiway_traffic/issues[/url]

The most useful thing to attach is your log file:
[i]%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Apoapsis Studios\Airport CEO\Player.log[/i]

Whenever the mod finds aircraft it can't free, it writes a warning naming them and where they are, so that file usually explains a stuck aircraft on its own. A screenshot and your save help too — Steam comments can't take file attachments, which is why reports go to GitHub.

If you can make the problem happen again, switch on [i]Overtaking → Log overtakes[/i] in Configuration Manager (F1) first. It records every decision leading up to it, which is far more to work with.

Anything that doesn't need a file attached is fine in the comments here.
author: Rhamnos
